On 6/18/13 9:27 PM, Peter Li wrote:
> Should I vectorize normal cdf? (In function signatures, there is a note that says "not vectorizing yet")

Yes, please do.

At the very least, the CDFs and related functions should
have all of the vectorized signatures even if the derivatives
aren't implemented efficiently.

We'd like to do this for all the functions in Stan, but there
are some details to work out. The new autodiff framework I
put in does it fairly elegantly, but not in the most efficient
way possible. I need to put that into a pull request --- I only
have one univariate function implemented this way. With the
trick Marcus introduced recently, it should be possible to at least
cut down on the number of virtual function calls, which are relatively
expensive compared to functions doing simple arithmetic.

- Bob
